final: WITH per_observatory AS (SELECT o.observstation, COUNT(t.telescregistry) AS telescope_count, 100.0 * COUNT(t.telescregistry) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM telescopes) AS share_pct FROM observatories AS o LEFT JOIN telescopes AS t ON t.observstation = o.observstation GROUP BY o.observstation), above_average AS (SELECT telescope_count, share_pct, AVG(share_pct) OVER () AS avg_share_pct FROM per_observatory) SELECT SUM(telescope_count) AS total_telescopes, AVG(share_pct) AS average_share_pct, AVG(share_pct - avg_share_pct) AS average_excess_share_pct FROM above_average WHERE share_pct > avg_share_pct
